wip for #34603 :33 

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->
existing mnnvl allreduce fusion backends already sum the ranks in fp32 but the trtllm one sums it in bf16 (which requires truncation after every rank) unless you pass fp32_acc but nothing actually passes `fp32_acc` as `True`...  as issue #34603 points out, TP=8 trtllm ends up doing seven bf16 roundings where mnnvl only does one --> the same model gets different numerics on SM90 (auto -> trtllm) than on Blackwell (auto -> mnnvl)

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->
adding default `fp32_acc=True` parameter in `python/sglang/srt/layers/flashinfer_comm_fusion.py`
## Accuracy Tests
qwen/qwen3.5-35B-A3B, TP=8, forced trtllm fusion backend, activation verified in both server logs

GPQA-Diamond accuracy:

| workload | n | bf16 | fp32 | request errors (bf16/fp32) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| greedy | 198 | 0.788 | 0.833 | 0 / 0 |
| sampled (t=0.6, 8 repeats) | 1584 | 0.850 | 0.831 | 0 / 0 |
| structured (JSON schema) | 198 | 0.258 | 0.273 | 0 / 0 |
| multiturn | 64 | 0.641 | 0.656 | 0 / 0 |

paired per-request comparison:

| workload | answer flips | bf16 right, fp32 wrong | fp32 right, bf16 wrong | one-sided errors |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| greedy | 25 | 4 | 13 | 0 |
| sampled | 194 | 94 | 65 | 0 |
| structured | 75 | 34 | 37 | 0 |
| multiturn | 10 | 4 | 5 | 0 |

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

## Speed Tests and Profiling

measured the accuracy and cost of fp32_acc=True vs False on the fused AR+residual+RMSNorm kernel (kARResidualRMSNorm), forced backend="trtllm", hardware is B300 (SM103), but this is the same trtllm kernel path that auto selects on SM90.

Method:
error is relative L2 against an fp64 reference of the whole fused pattern, computed from the same bf16 inputs the kernel sees. time is measured as CUPTI kernel time under CUDA-graph replay, median of 100 iters, cold L2, world_size (TP)=4, so bf16 accumulation rounds 3 times where fp32 rounds once. at every shape the bf16 and fp32 outputs are different tensors, so the flag is exercised, not a no-op.

| tokens | hidden | bf16 us | fp32 us | overhead | relerr bf16 | relerr fp32 | ratio |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 4096 | 6.11 | 5.91 | -3.30% | 3.164e-03 | 2.770e-03 | 1.14x |
| 4 | 4096 | 6.32 | 6.32 | +0.00% | 3.028e-03 | 2.711e-03 | 1.12x |
| 16 | 4096 | 6.73 | 6.52 | -3.00% | 3.106e-03 | 2.725e-03 | 1.14x |
| 64 | 4096 | 8.98 | 8.78 | -2.25% | 3.110e-03 | 2.733e-03 | 1.14x |
| 256 | 4096 | 16.35 | 16.15 | -1.23% | 3.098e-03 | 2.732e-03 | 1.13x |
| 1024 | 4096 | 59.37 | 58.85 | -0.88% | 3.102e-03 | 2.729e-03 | 1.14x |
| 4096 | 4096 | 152.65 | 152.65 | -0.00% | 3.101e-03 | 2.728e-03 | 1.14x |
| 1 | 8192 | 6.32 | 6.12 | -3.19% | 3.078e-03 | 2.751e-03 | 1.12x |
| 4 | 8192 | 6.52 | 6.32 | -3.09% | 3.126e-03 | 2.748e-03 | 1.14x |
| 16 | 8192 | 7.34 | 7.34 | +0.00% | 3.084e-03 | 2.703e-03 | 1.14x |
| 64 | 8192 | 11.59 | 11.38 | -1.80% | 3.089e-03 | 2.727e-03 | 1.13x |
| 256 | 8192 | 28.54 | 28.23 | -1.08% | 3.100e-03 | 2.730e-03 | 1.14x |
| 1024 | 8192 | 79.22 | 79.22 | +0.00% | 3.100e-03 | 2.730e-03 | 1.14x |
| 4096 | 8192 | 250.79 | 250.35 | -0.18% | 3.101e-03 | 2.728e-03 | 1.14x |

serving throughput, 3 repeated runs per variant (`sglang.bench_serving`, random dataset, 1000 prompts, input/output 1000/1000, concurrency 100):

| run | bf16 req/s | fp32 req/s | bf16 mean TPOT ms | fp32 mean TPOT ms |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| r1 | 20.96 | 22.32 | 9.18 | 8.61 |
| r2 | 23.64 | 23.62 | 8.10 | 8.10 |
| r3 | 23.83 | 23.55 | 8.02 | 8.11 |
| median | 23.64 | 23.62 | 8.10 | 8.10 |

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->
currently profiling how much fp32 accumulations costs across queries (GPTQA)
